name: Doublecross Bow
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Doublecross Bow

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Poison Blast
effects.tooltip: Poison Blast 4 : This weapon drips with vile poison, dealing 4d6 Poison damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Poison damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Crippling
effects.tooltip: Crippling : A crippling weapon is infused with binding power so that when a target is critically hit their movement is slowed by half. Note: Real slowdown is only 25%

effects.name: Armor-Piercing
effects.tooltip: Armor-Piercing 12% : Passive: +12% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

effects.name: Nightshade Venom
effects.tooltip: Nightshade Venom : Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a Difficulty Check 22 Fortitude save or fall unconscious. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the sleep lasts for 20 seconds.

flavor_text: The drow of Faerun's Underdark favor small handcrossbows that can be used quickly, silently, and with poisoned ammunition. The bolts fired from this light repeating weapon will inject a struck target with a venom that may put it to sleep instantly.
tips: Unique in that it allows using INT mod for attack bonus.

source.detail: End Chest (to the right of The Silver Flame)
source.raw: The Spinner of Shadows , End Chest (to the right of The Silver Flame)
